ctx.x: Tio was the brother-in-law. He married one of the Bocage sisters. Now, Cottrell, the drummer, was a cousin. Leroy married one of his cousins. So they was all intermingled with the whole family. So you didn't get into that band unless somebody died. Because they're all depend on... Their wives and their families depend on that band as... And everybody was particular who came in the band; you know, who was taking whose place. You had to be respectable. You had to be able to read music, and you had to be what is…

Now, Steve Lewis was the piano player. It was an orchestra. It wasn't in the sense of a Jazz band. This was an orchestra. And they played in opposition to Joe Robichaux and Papa Celestin. They had to lead three orchestras.
